title: SpecEyes: Accelerating Agentic Multimodal LLMs via Speculative Perception and Planning

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI can now *see* and *think* at the same time?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This breakthrough changes how we interact with AI in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: SpecEyes is a new system that speeds up agentic multimodal AI like Gemini and o3.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses speculative perception to predict and plan actions before they happen.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This means faster, smarter responses in complex tasks like vision and reasoning.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is reducing delays between seeing, thinking, and acting.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this could change your next AI interaction?
